typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		HLDR_POS as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		CUSIP_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		POS_DIFF as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		COD_COR_NET as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		HLDR_POS as integer,
		EFFDATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		CUSIP_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT as string,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR as string,
		FAIL_AMT as string,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD as string,
		POS_DIFF as string,
		BRANCH_CD as string,
		CLIENT_NBR as string,
		ACCOUNT_CD as string,
		COD_COR_NET as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		HLDR_POS,
		EFFDATE,
		TYPE_ACCOUNT_CD,
		CUSIP_NBR,
		ACCOUNT,
		SECURITY_ADP_NBR,
		FAIL_AMT,
		ISO_CURRENCY_CD,
		POS_DIFF,
		BRANCH_CD,
		CLIENT_NBR,
		ACCOUNT_CD,
		COD_COR_NET),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
